candidateOccurrences.sourceText: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 本文はミディアンの首長たちという集団を指し、地名ではない。場所プロフィールから除外。

wikipediaSearchNoteJa: 固定WEB JOS13:21の “chiefs of Midian” は民族/集団の首長を指し、地名ではないとしてプロフィール対象から除外済み。地名Wikipedia記事は結び付けない。
rightsNoteJa: WEB public domain. Candidate index CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution retained; candidate coordinates not promoted.
auditNoteJa: 修正: JOS 13:20–22の固定WEB本文を文脈込みで再確認し、13:21の “chiefs of Midian” は地名ではなく民族/集団の首長を指すため、この場所候補プロフィールを除外。候補点・候補座標も場所としては棄却。
profileRewriteNoteJa: 初出節の文脈に合わせ、地形/水域/地域/町/旅程/祭儀を区別する紹介に再記述。将来の書内情報は加えず、現代比定はqualifiedのまま。

authorCorrection.sourceText: …whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba…
authorCorrection.decisionJa: “of Midian” attaches to “chiefs”; no Midian place is named in this verse. Exclude this place candidate; no substitute ID created.
